content:
We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have IR spectrum with a peak at 1714 cm-1, typical carbonyl stretch. Need to know if there are multiple carbonyls. Only one strong carbonyl peak appears. Could be multiple carbonyls overlapping but likely one. No other carbonyl peaks (e.g., around 1730, 1700). So answer likely 1.

We could also get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~200 ppm). But IR suggests one. To be safe, maybe check carbon NMR. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
